definitions: There are many other potential romantic partners or opportunities available.
Don't dwell on one lost opportunity or person, as others will come along.
examples: Don't worry about that breakup, there are plenty more fish in the sea.
She didn't get the job, but there are plenty more fish in the sea.
lemma: plenty more fish in the sea
synonyms: many more fish in the sea
source: plenty more fish in the sea
